summary: This clinical trial is studying different ways to manage diabetes medications for people with type 2 diabetes. The study compares adjusting medicine based on standard blood sugar testing to adjusting medicine using self-monitored blood glucose levels. The trial has a status of Active, not recruiting and aims to see how these approaches affect the body's ability to produce insulin. A total of 127 participants are included in the research.
